genes.body: Validate tool JSON against schema before calling. Retry once with diff on failure. Never invent file paths; check Vault graph first.
Split ambiguous jobs: 3-7 step plan card first, get approval, then build. Well-specified edits build directly.
Max 5 colors, 2 fonts. No purple gradients, no Inter/Roboto defaults, no emoji icons, no centered-everything, no lorem, no invented metrics.
Blue=input, Black=formula, Green=intra-link, Red=external, Yellow=assumption. $#,##0 and 0.0%. Years as TEXT. Reference assumption cells, never hardcode. recalc must be 0 errors.
Every metric needs source [doc p.X] or tool output. No source -> say 'not in SOP'. Placeholders use em-dash + grey 'to confirm'.
Load only tools the step needs. Prefer local Vault search before generation. Checkpoint state card every 4 turns.
